positions.as_written: Treat a halved contact area as a doubled stress, which is the arithmetic behind the meniscectomy literature.
Consider shear as well as compression when a delamination or osteochondral lesion is the problem.
Treat peak contact stress as the common currency of every mechanical argument in the knee.
Expect a cartilage repair of different stiffness to distribute load differently from the original.
